word.description: Word text, at most 500 characters. In a language that separates words with spaces, send one word per entry and keep the space that separates it from its neighbour at the start or end of the entry (`Hello ` then `world`); a whole sentence in one entry works for export but gives up word-level timing. In a language written without spaces (for example Japanese, Chinese or Thai) entries are joined exactly as sent.

is_eos.description: Whether this word ends a sentence
